body:
## What's new in 0.1.28

### Mac
- **Pictures no longer get stuck on "Generating…".** The engine let one picture take all of the Mac's memory, so the Mac slowed to a crawl. It now stays within a safe limit, and Macs with 16 GB or less free the model after each picture.
- **Opens in full screen**, with the Mac's own red / yellow / green buttons.
- **Updates install by themselves** from this version on: click Update and the app reopens on the new version.
- **Quitting with ⌘Q now stops the AI engine** too, so it no longer keeps running in the background.
- **The Mac stays awake** while a picture is being made.
- **Better model suggestions** for 8 GB Macs (SD 1.5 models such as Realistic Vision run best there).
- Shortcuts are shown the Mac way (⌘Z, ⇧⌘S), and scrolling is smoother.

### Everyone
- **Stop really stops.** The picture used to keep drawing in the background after Stop; now the engine stops within a second.
- **Slow computers aren't cut off.** The app waits as long as a picture keeps making progress instead of giving up after 8 minutes.
- When a picture finishes while you're in another app, the Dock icon bounces (Mac) or the taskbar button flashes (Windows).
- Opens filling the screen on Windows and Linux.
- A little faster on every computer (no hidden step-by-step previews are drawn).

Intel Macs aren't supported: on-device AI needs a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer).
